title: US Trade Deficit Surges Amid Artificial Intelligence Spending Boom
summary: The United States' trade deficit has increased significantly due to a surge in artificial intelligence spending, with imports outpacing exports by $77.6 billion in May. This imbalance is driven primarily by pharmaceuticals and semiconductors. The US trade deficit has been on the rise in recent months, with capital goods imports reaching record highs.
summary_points: The US trade deficit has increased significantly due to a surge in artificial intelligence spending.
Imports outpaced exports by $77.6 billion in May, driven primarily by pharmaceuticals and semiconductors.
Capital goods imports have reached record highs in recent months.
The US trade deficit has been on the rise in recent months.
Artificial intelligence spending is a key driver of the increased imbalance.
